data.task_title: Create Artemis self-demo with Chart.js visualization

features.title: Live Metrics Dashboard
features.description: Develop a real-time dashboard with various Chart.js graphs.
acceptance_criteria: Include a line chart for LLM cost over time.
Use a bar chart for stage completion rates.
Create an area chart for success rate trends.

features.title: Chart.js Integration
features.description: Integrate Chart.js for data visualization within the presentation.
acceptance_criteria: Include Chart.js library in the HTML file.
Create visualizations for pipeline metrics, cost tracking, and success rates.
Ensure charts are interactive and visually appealing.

features.title: Code Quality Metrics
features.description: Visualize TDD compliance and SOLID principles using a radar chart.
acceptance_criteria: Create a radar chart for TDD compliance and SOLID principles.
Ensure metrics are accurate and reflect current practices.
Use Chart.js for an engaging presentation.

features.title: Pipeline Visualization
acceptance_criteria: Create a clear and accurate representation of the 8-stage pipeline.
Use Chart.js to enhance the visualization.
Ensure the pipeline visualization is easy to understand.

features.title: Results Presentation
features.description: Display real metrics from recent runs in the presentation.
acceptance_criteria: Include actual data in the presentation.
Ensure data is presented clearly and accurately.
Use charts to enhance data visualization.

features.title: Feature Metrics Visualization
features.description: Showcase cost tracking, sandboxing, and learning metrics using charts.
acceptance_criteria: Create charts for cost tracking, sandboxing, and learning metrics.
Ensure metrics are accurate and up-to-date.
Use Chart.js for interactive and engaging visualizations.

features.title: Auto-Advance and Navigation Controls
features.description: Implement auto-advance functionality and navigation controls for slides.
acceptance_criteria: Slides should auto-advance after a set duration.
Include navigation controls for manual slide navigation.
Ensure controls are intuitive and responsive.

features.title: HTML Presentation Template
features.description: Create a standalone HTML file using existing demos as templates.
acceptance_criteria: Use contract_analytics_dashboard.html, lead_opportunity_intelligence_demo.html, and artemis_complete_demo.html as references.
Embed CSS and JavaScript directly into the HTML file.
Ensure the HTML file is standalone and does not rely on external resources.

features.title: HERO Slide: Introduction to Artemis
features.description: Create an introductory slide explaining Artemis as an Autonomous AI Development System.
acceptance_criteria: Include a clear and concise description of Artemis.
Use engaging visuals to capture attention.
Ensure the slide sets the tone for the rest of the presentation.

features.title: Professional Design
features.description: Design a professional presentation with gradient backgrounds and smooth transitions.
acceptance_criteria: Use a professional gradient background throughout the presentation.
Implement smooth transitions between slides.
Ensure the design is consistent and visually appealing.

features.title: Supervisor Integration Visualization
features.description: Illustrate supervisor integration across stages using a pie chart.
acceptance_criteria: Create a pie chart to show supervisor integration.
Ensure the chart is clear and informative.
Use Chart.js for interactive elements.
